main_text.p: 180. Martini hæc collectio per errorem, pro Martini Papæ canonibus habita.gligendum sed monendum, quod ante Antonii Democharis editionem Decreti Gratiani, Collectio hæc Martini Bracharensis, citata sit, quasi essent capitula Martini Papæ Romani, qui tamen multis annis posterior est Martino nostro. Hosce errores Gratiani correxit in sua editione Democharesque & Contius, qui in margine quando Gratianus scribit: Ex concilio Martini Papæ, notant: Martini Bracharensis nomen, ex capitulis Græcarum synodorum. Latissime hac de re agit Ant. Augustinus noster, Dialogorum lib. I. Dialog. X. XI. & XII. quorum primus sic incipit, & hæc quæ potissimum ad rem præsentem faciunt, habet. Credo vos non ignorare, si Gratiani librum ab Ant. Demochare, vel ab Ant. Contio editum legistis: in omnibus fere capitibus, quæ habent hanc inscriptionem: Ex concilio Martini Papæ: additum esse in margine Martini Bracarensis nomen, ex capitulis Græcarum synodorum. Quod à Democharc factum est, sumitur ex libris conciliorum, in quibus post secundum Bracarense concilium, illa capita sunt Martini Episcopi, qui se ex Orientis conciliis ea sumere dicit, offensus varia interpretatione eorum. Unde autem singula capita sumantur, non adscripsit, quod sciam? sed ego ea conferens cum Græcis

page.notes: The side note is in the left margin; the first printed line reads "180. Mar-", with the note's hyphenated words continued as printed. Some words in the main text are partly obscured by stains. Line "Democharesque" is read as printed "Demochares" & Contius; the printed text reads "Demochares" with "& Contius" and is partly faint. The word "Democharc" and "Demochare" are uncertain readings in places ("Demochare" is clear at the first occurrence). Text in the margin is partly illegible at the far left edge.
